::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 3d [1880s?]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/29
:::

Dear Madam

Thank you most heartily for sending me this most laborious and excellent piece of work.  I hope to keep it with my volumes and make it useful[^1]

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The piece of work was perhaps an index to [*MP*](organizations/other_52.qmd).
